name: Camp College at Willamette University
what_you_do: A free 3 day, 2 night college camp on campus. You get a sample class, college search and application workshops, financial aid 101 and visits to nearby colleges.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors committed to pursuing a four-year college or university. Must be on track to graduate high school in June 2027 or June 2028. The page lists no age requirement.
pay_detail: Free. Meals, housing and transport to college visits are covered. Students get themselves to and from campus.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due May 18, 2026, with answers by mid-June. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Send in the Camp College form on the Willamette page by the deadline.
notes: The page says parents and family are invited to 2 closing sessions. They come before pickup.
